title: Design Optimization of Nuclear Fusion Reactor through Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2409.08231v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this research, we investigate deep reinforcement learning (DRL) as a practical tool for constrained, multi-objective optimization for tokamak fusion reactor designs. The task is to optimize the design configurations that minimize building cost while achieving high energy gain and long energy confinement time, subject to the four operational limits required for stable operation. Due to the coupled physics-engineering evaluation, the resulting objectives and constraints are black-box, making it challenging to find optimal solutions with conventional search strategies. To address this, we implement Reward-Constrained Policy Optimization (RCPO) for tokamak fusion reactor design. This method integrates multiple constraints into the reward functions, guiding the policy towards feasible solutions and simplifying the design optimization process. translated_title: 基于深度强化学习的核聚变反应堆设计优化
translated_abstract: 在这项研究中，我们探讨了深度强化学习（DRL）作为托卡马克聚变反应堆设计中带约束的多目标优化的实用工具。该任务是优化设计配置，在满足稳定运行所需的四个运行限制条件下，最小化建造成本，同时实现高能量增益和长能量约束时间。由于物理与工程的耦合评估，所得的目标和约束是黑箱的，这使得采用传统搜索策略寻找最优解变得具有挑战性。为解决这一问题，我们在托卡马克聚变反应堆设计中实现了奖励约束策略优化（RCPO）方法。该方法将多个约束整合到奖励函数中，引导策略向可行解方向优化，并简化了设计优化过程。我们的数值结果表明，所提出的基于DRL的方法能够找到更多可行的设计方案。
tldr: 该研究将深度强化学习中的奖励约束策略优化（RCPO）应用于托卡马克聚变反应堆设计，在满足四个稳定运行约束的条件下，实现了对建造成本、能量增益和能量约束时间的多目标黑箱优化。
en_tdlr: This study applies Reward-Constrained Policy Optimization (RCPO), a deep reinforcement learning method, to tokamak fusion reactor design, enabling multi-objective black-box optimization of construction cost, energy gain, and energy confinement time under four operational constraints.
